description: This file defines the 'NoteSoap' class, which provides functionalities for handling file uploads, retrievals, and related operations within the Notes module of SuiteCRM. It interacts with the UploadFile utility and notes data beans, focusing on saving and retrieving note attachments through SOAP web services.

classes.name: NoteSoap
classes.description: Class providing SOAP API for managing note file uploads, downloads, and associated metadata handling in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: saveFile
methods.description: Saves an uploaded file to a Note record, decoding base64 content, validating IDs, and updating the record with file info.

methods.name: newSaveFile
methods.description: Creates or updates a Note record with a new file attachment, and associates it with related modules if specified.

methods.name: retrieveFile
methods.description: Retrieves and base64-encodes the content of a file associated with a Note record.
